Read a field of an instance

Source: R/struct.R
instance-get.Rd

Matching is exact: x$nam is an error rather than a quiet hit on name, which is what a plain list would do.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'typed_instance'
x$name

# S3 method for class 'typed_instance'
x[[i, ...]]

Arguments

x

An instance.

name, i

A field name, or a position.

...

Ignored.

Value

The field's value.

Examples

Card <- struct("Card", holder = chr[1], number = chr[1])
cc <- Card(holder = "Ada", number = "4111")
cc$holder
#> [1] "Ada"
cc[["number"]]
#> [1] "4111"
try(cc$holdr)
#> Error : <Card> has no field `holdr` -- did you mean `holder`?
#>   fields: holder, number
